name: lightbox
need: Look at the images of a record one at a time over the whole window, with thumbnails, zoom and a caption

--ds-lightbox-bg.default: `--ds-inverse` in the light scheme, `--ds-backdrop` in the dark one
--ds-lightbox-bg.description: lightbox: the viewer's canvas (dark in both schemes)

--ds-lightbox-ink.default: `--ds-on-inverse` in the light scheme, `--ds-text` in the dark one
--ds-lightbox-ink.description: lightbox: the viewer's text, icons and the current thumbnail's ring

--ds-lightbox-thumb-size.description: lightbox: a thumbnail in the viewer's row, at least the touch target under `.ds-touch`

--ds-lightbox-item-size.description: lightbox: the smallest column of the gallery (`.ds-lightbox__gallery`)

--ds-lightbox-radius.description: lightbox: the gallery's items and the thumbnails at the default shape

labExempt.DS.lightbox.create: events only: the viewer opens as a dialog, shown in the entry lightbox-open
labExempt.DS.lightbox.show: the same viewer as DS.lightbox.open, shown in the entry lightbox-open
